neighbours.label: An object pronoun for a person right after a verb, strongest on ' me' (' him' and ' her' weaker); the same verbs with a noun object stay quiet
fire: The smell of fresh bread always reminds me of my childhood summers.
The long drive from the coast exhausted me more than the work did.
That old photograph convinced me to call the family again.
The strange noise in the attic frightened me during the night.
The final chapter of the book moved me to tears.
The early start on Monday annoyed me for the whole day.
The long drive through the hills exhausted him more than the work did.
The strange letter from the bank worried her for days.
quiet: The smell of fresh bread always reminds the town of its early summers.
The long drive from the coast exhausted the horses more than the work did.
That old photograph convinced the family to call the police again.
The strange noise in the attic frightened the cat during the night.
The final chapter of the book moved the plot to its end.
The early start on Monday annoyed the staff for the whole day.
The long drive through the hills damaged the engine more than the work did.
The strange letter from the bank worried the board for days.

short: object pronoun for a person, mostly ' me'
notes: Card: ' me' x29 of the top 32, all after verbs (brings me, made me, inspired me); gate-closed echo regime, broad. Probe: ' me' 0.66-0.95, ' him' 0.39-0.66, ' her' 0.39-0.43, ' us' 0.47, noun objects 0.11-0.16, ' it' 0.18. Sentence-initial pronouns also reach about 0.5, so the test keeps them away from the first token. Not claimed: Chinese 我 belongs to the other pole.
